product_metadata.title: Paksh Novelty 1-Gallon Glass Jar Wide Mouth with Airtight Metal Lid 2-Pack USDA Approved BPA-Free Dishwasher Safe Clear Mason Jar for Fermenting Kombucha Kefir Storing and Canning - Chalkboard Labels
features: 1-gallon glass jar perfect for an assortment of purposes. Whether as a SCOBY hotel for brewing kombucha or sun tea, pickling, canning, this large mason jar will surely come in handy. Also great for dry food storage of pasta, beans, and oats.

The 1-gallon jar includes a white metal screw-on lid that opens easily, while closing securely. The preserving jar’s lid includes a plastisol liner that creates a vacuum seal, ensuring contents stay fresh.

Our wide-mouth jar is perfect for filling with large fruits and vegetables such as cucumbers, carrots, green tomatoes, and peaches. The fermentation jar’s 4 inch wide mouth allows for easy accessibility to reach deep inside and clean.

Clear glass kombucha jars allow for quick and easy visibility of contents. The brewing jars are certified by the USDA, ensuring the glass is food grade, won’t leach harmful chemicals into foods, and never absorbs flavors.
Paksh Novelty’s large pickling jar is dishwasher safe—although it is recommended lid be washed by hand. Dimensions: 10" tall with a 4" wide opening.
